items.reason: Gap 0 says two in-flight deliveries both find the id absent before either inserts it, so both process the event.
Gap 1 says the dedup key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a replayed signed body with a fresh header changes the key.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so refunds are never recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, and gap 0 concerns the queue's concurrency within one process.
